Bug_Title: Return values should not be ignored when they contain the operation status code
Bug_Explanation: The bug is that the return value of the file.delete() method is not being checked, which means that if the file does not exist or if the delete operation fails for any reason, the program will not detect it.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method in the BuggyCode class, which calls the delete method on a File object without checking the return value. This violates the rule that return values should not be ignored when they contain the operation status code.
